sentences.text: Heard finally with the consent of parties.

This revision petition has been filed under Section 397 of the Cr.P.C. against order dated 06.02.2023 passed by the 8 th Additional Sessions Judge and Special Judge, (O.A.W.) Indore in S.T.
No.351/2019 whereby the trial Court has rejected the application of the petitioner filed under Section 311 of Code of Criminal Procedure.

entities.text: 8 th Additional Sessions Judge and Special Judge, (O.A.W.) Indore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. Facts of the case in brief:- S.T. No.351/2019 is pending against the petitioner under section 354(D)(i), 450, 376(2)(n) and 506(2) of the Indian Penal Code before the trial Court.

In the case,

sentences.text: examination-in-chief of the witness was recorded on 30.07.2022 thereafter, on 09.09.2022 and 29.10.2022

Investigating Officer, Ms. Ankita Mandloi (P.W.-4) was also present before the trial court but the trial court had adjourned cross-examination of the witness on the request of learned counsel for the petitioner but adjournment was sought on the ground that counsel for the petitioner was out of station.
Therefore, the learned trial court has closed opportunity of cross-examination of the witness.

On 02.01.2023 an application was filed on behalf of the petitioner under section 311 of the Code of Criminal Procedure before the trial Court which was rejected vide order dated 06.02.2023.
3 .

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that Investigating Officer, Ms. Ankita Mandloi (P.W.-4) is an important witness to adjudicate the whole controversy but the learned trial court has committed grave error of law in rejecting the application filed under section 311 of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
Due to unavailable of options for the petitioner before the trial court the cross-examination could not be conducted.
Hence the petitioner is entitled for cross examination of the said witness because the petitioner has ample material to establish that he is innocent.
The petitioner is facing trial on false case and he is well entitle to get recalling of the witness who is important to prove his innocence.
4 . Learned G.A. for the respondent/State supported the impugned order and prays for its rejection of the application.
I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
5 . Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, it appears that the aforesaid Session trial is related to heinous offence which is pending against the petitioner.

It also appears that adjournment was granted by the trial Court to the petitioner for cross examination of the Investigating Officer, Ms. Ankita Mandloi (P.W.-4) and lastly his opportunity to cross examination was closed therefore, considering over all material produced on record the present revision is liable to be allowed and resultantly the revision petition is allowed and impugned order dated 06.02.2023 is hereby set aside with a direction to the trial Court to fix the date and recall the witness on the fix date.
The petitioner shall conclude his cross-examination on the witness i.e. Investigating Officer, Ms. Ankita Mandloi (P.W.-4) on the same day.
It is made clear that no further adjournment shall be granted in favour of the petitioner.
6. With the aforesaid the Revision Petition is disposed of.

(PRAKASH CHANDRA GUPTA) JUDGE ajit Shavej Khan @ Shoab vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/111464026/
